coverage.name: Yuma County
limitations: The clerk's Notice of General Election (certified Sep 18, 2026) gives "a complete listing of ballot content for Yuma County". It lists no county measure. Its local measures are "City of Wray Referred Ballot Issue 2A" and school district measures "RE-1J Referred Ballot Issue 5A" and "RE-6J Referred Ballot Issue 5D".
All twelve posted sample ballot styles (001-01 to 007-01) were read from their searchable text on 2026-10-10. None has a county measure.
The BOCC minutes for Jul 30, 2026 mention 'future election ballot questions' without naming any. The certified ballot content shows that no county question was referred.
No referral resolution was found among the posted BOCC minutes (Jul 6 - Aug 13, 2026, including the Aug 13 minutes) or the Sep 5, 2026 agenda, reviewed 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Eckley (town)
limitations: The county's certified complete ballot content (Notice of General Election, Sep 18, 2026) lists no Town of Eckley measure, and none of the twelve sample ballot styles has an Eckley section. Rechecked 2026-10-12: the Yuma County elections page links the same notice and styles, and no participating-entities list is posted.

Left at official_notice_unavailable (checked 2026-10-12): no participating-entities list and no town election page or notice to read.

coverage.name: Wray (city)
limitations: Wray participates. Its one measure appears on styles 001-04 and 002-04 and in the certified ballot content. Excluded as not housing (street sales tax): "City of Wray Ballot Question 2A: SHALL THE CITY OF WRAY, COLORADO, IMPROVE STREETS, ALLEYS AND RELATED INFRASTRUCTURE IMPROVEMENTS AND MAINTENANCE BY INCREASING THE CITY'S SALES AND USE TAX BY THREE-QUARTER PERCENT (0.75%), COMMENCING JANUARY 1, 2027, TO GENERATE APPROXIMATELY ($525,000) ANNUALLY IN THE FIRST FISCAL YEAR AND BY WHATEVER ADDITIONAL AMOUNTS ARE RAISED ANNUALLY IN EACH SUBSEQUENT YEAR WITH ALL REVENUES COLLECTED, RETAINED, AND SPENT AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE WITHOUT REGARD TO ANY SPENDING OR REVENUE LIMITATION CONTAINED IN ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION OR ANY OTHER LAW?"
The notice heads it "City of Wray Referred Ballot Issue 2A", while the sample ballot heads it "City of Wray Ballot Question 2A".
The city AgendaCenter still posts 2026 agendas only through Jun 9, 2026.
The Jun 9, 2026 agenda and May 12, 2026 minutes, reviewed 2026-09-26, contain no ballot or election items.

coverage.name: Yuma (city)
limitations: The county's certified complete ballot content (Notice of General Election, Sep 18, 2026) lists no City of Yuma measure, and none of the twelve sample ballot styles has a City of Yuma section.

The city has no elections page. Its latest council minutes, Sep 1, 2026 (MIN090126.pdf) and Sep 3, 2026 (MIN090326.pdf), are image-only scans with no searchable text, so the town-side check could not be completed. The Jun 2 to Aug 3, 2026 minutes, which are text, contain no ballot, election or IGA items.
News reports mention a Yuma marijuana tax question. That appears to be the 2021 question (Resolution #27, Series of 2021), not 2026. It is not housing either way.
